header: What receiving docks say about our deliveries
subheadline: Every delivery ends with a two-question survey at the receiving dock. These answers are from the last quarter.

testimonials.quote: The driver called ahead at 05:40, reversed onto bay 3 without help and left the yard 18 minutes later.
Loaded and strapped properly. The chipped tiles stopped the week the dedicated trailer started.
Fish left Tromsø at 18:00 and reached Hamburg the next afternoon, still at 1 °C.
